note: Colombia: a foreigner coming for under 90 days for concerts, events or artistic activities needs no visa where the visits engine says so, but must hold the Permit for Other Activities (POA) from Migración Colombia, requested by a Colombian company for each person; an employment relationship with a Colombian company, or a stay beyond 90 days, needs a visa from the Foreign Ministry (Proimágenes Colombia's Colombian Film Commission instructions, version 5 of 9 February 2026). No days of paid work without a permit are named. Read from the Film Commission's copy since cancilleria.gov.co refuses this client.

sources.title: Comisión Fílmica Colombiana (Proimágenes Colombia), FC-IN-1 v5: Instructivo ingreso extranjeros – solicitud visas (09/02/2026)
sources.said: Cuando el personal extranjero ingresa a Colombia por un período inferior a noventa (90) días, no se requiere visa. No obstante, es obligatorio tramitar el Permiso para Otras Actividades (POA) a través del formulario de Migración Colombia, seleccionando la opción “Conciertos, eventos o actividades artísticas”.
